comments.note: tests/AppFrameworkTests/API/Cache/UserScopedCacheTest.php — test_emptyIdentifierExceptionType is redundant with test_emptyUserIdentifierThrowsAPICacheException: both verify APICacheException + ERROR_EMPTY_USER_CACHE_IDENTIFIER with different assertion styles. tests/AppFrameworkTests/API/Cache/CacheResilienceTest.php line 143 — fclose($resource) is unreachable dead code (PropagatingException exits the method before that line). PHP GC reclaims the php://memory resource safely on test teardown, so there is no observable defect. Consider wrapping the throwing call in a try/finally block if the file is ever extended beyond in-memory resources (e.g., real file handles). Non-blocking.
